acceptanceCriteria: historical_finalization_inventory reads the .ai/decisions directory listing exactly once per call (materialized), builds an in-memory work_item_id -> transition-candidate index from that single listing, and resolve_resource_finalization_head_with_candidates consumes pre-filtered candidates instead of calling fs::read_dir per outer-loop item.

resolve_resource_finalization_head (used by finalize/finalize-verify/finalize-recovery-plan call sites) keeps its existing signature, behavior, and per-call directory scan unchanged; only historical_finalization_inventory's internal call path changes.

A new regression test proves historical_finalization_inventory produces byte-identical HistoricalFinalizationInventoryItem output before and after the change for a fixture with multiple legacy receipts, including at least one with a resolved transition chain and one that fails resolution.

The corrected runtime_benchmark.sh harness (WI-647) measures status cold/warm latency before and after this change on this repository, with raw samples retained; the candidate must not regress inspect/doctor/observe and must show a measured reduction in status latency proportional to the removed re-scans, not an assumed one.
cargo fmt, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, and cargo test --locked --workspace pass; no governance decision, evidence semantics, or JSON field changes.
goal: Reduce ai-cockpit status latency on repositories with accumulated history (measured at ~1.8s on this repository) by removing redundant directory re-scanning, while producing byte-identical HistoricalFinalizationInventoryItem output for every existing receipt.
intent: Fix the O(n^2) directory re-scan that WI-648 root-caused in historical_finalization_inventory: resolve_resource_finalization_head currently re-scans the full .ai/decisions directory once per outer-loop legacy receipt. Build the transition-candidate index once per historical_finalization_inventory call instead, with zero output/behavior change.
outOfScope: Caching resolved historical_finalization_inventory results across separate status invocations (WI-648's second candidate); this WI only removes the redundant directory re-scan within a single call
or any other readiness step; only resolve_resource_finalization_head's directory-scan cost is addressed
Any change to the ResourceFinalizationReceipt/HistoricalFinalizationInventoryItem schema or the finalize/finalize-verify/finalize-recovery-plan call sites of resolve_resource_finalization_head
